hints.title: Endpoint Choice and Span Analysis
hints.text: Sorting the stone positions reveals the total available vacant slots. In each move, an endpoint is shifted inward, eliminating empty slots on either the left or right flank.

hints.title: Maximum Moves Formula
hints.text: To maximize moves, we sacrifice only one empty slot per step. The maximum number of moves is the total unoccupied interior slots minus the smaller of the two initial endpoint gaps.

hints.title: Sliding Window for Minimum Moves
hints.text: Find a window of span at most n. The minimum moves to pack stones into length n is n minus stones in window, except when n - 1 stones are contiguous with the last stone far away, which takes 2 moves.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating stone transitions naively explores a state space of combinatorial explosion.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting followed by a two-pointer sliding window finds bounds in O(N log N) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should derive closed-form maximum moves and use a sliding window of size n for minimum moves.
complexity.notes: Special case occurs when n - 1 stones are already contiguous (requires 2 moves).
